s4_attain_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region ORDER BY sr.sales_region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT sr.sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) AS total_closed_revenue FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY sr.sales_region ORDER BY sr.sales_region
s4_attain_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id IN (SELECT sr.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr JOIN hr_bridge hb ON sr.employee_id = hb.employee_id JOIN learners l ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN course_completions cc ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')
s4_attain_no_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE o.employee_id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM sales_reps) AND o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT sr.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr JOIN hr_bridge hb ON sr.employee_id = hb.employee_id JOIN learners l ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN course_completions cc ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation')
s4_attain_by_advneg: SELECT CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT sr2.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr2 JOIN hr_bridge hb ON sr2.employee_id = hb.employee_id JOIN learners l ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN course_completions cc ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END AS advneg_status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
s4_assess_emea: SELECT AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores a JOIN learners l ON a.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge hb ON l.email = hb.work_email JOIN sales_reps sr ON hb.employee_id = sr.employee_id WHERE sr.sales_region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id WHERE sr.sales_region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_by_distract: SELECT CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT sr2.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr2 JOIN hr_bridge hb ON sr2.employee_id = hb.employee_id JOIN learners l ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN course_completions cc ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Intro to Spreadsheets') THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END AS spreadsheets_status, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
s5_advneg_lift: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN o.employee_id IN (SELECT sr2.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr2 JOIN hr_bridge hb ON sr2.employee_id = hb.employee_id JOIN learners l ON hb.work_email = l.email JOIN course_completions cc ON l.learner_id = cc.learner_id JOIN courses c ON cc.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') THEN o.quota_attainment END) - AVG(CASE WHEN o.employee_id NOT IN (SELECT sr3.employee_id FROM sales_reps sr3 JOIN hr_bridge hb2 ON sr3.employee_id = hb2.employee_id JOIN learners l2 ON hb2.work_email = l2.email JOIN course_completions cc2 ON l2.learner_id = cc2.learner_id JOIN courses c2 ON cc2.course_id = c2.course_id WHERE c2.course_name = 'Advanced Negotiation') THEN o.quota_attainment END) AS attainment_lift FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps sr ON o.employee_id = sr.employee_id
s4_unans_manager: SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS manager, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o WHERE FALSE
s4_unans_age: SELECT CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS age_band, AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores a WHERE FALSE
